primaryReadingLimits: Original ASCO2026 journal full text inaccessible; complete abstract and specified official practice-summary blocks read.
EANM2025 technical body inaccessible; definitions attributed to read 2015 version2 passages.
BPE/Hylton full-text retrieval failed; their complete abstracts support the scoped claims. BioC responses were error text, not full articles.

The PSMA therapy XML is truncated and fails parsing; the complete abstract, one complete closed paragraph on lutetium-177 emission, and explicitly inherited earlier dosimetry scope are used. No complete-document XML reading is claimed.
GIVIO group/contributor metadata, a Rosselli DOI alias redirect and Farwell online/print/title drift are documented, not treated as scientific identity conflicts.
SURVIVE is a protocol, not an outcome report. A 2026 INSPIRE conference item was only a search lead; blocked raw page, no result adopted.
The current registry capture for SURVIVE and reused MRI-vascular body were not read for new claims; no current trial-status or new vascular result is inferred.
No live Elicit scientific interface was callable. Frozen 917-occurrence discovery accounting is unchanged; no question/report/response invented.
Earlier catalogue assertions outside the selected fields and inherited PERCIST/PSMA statements are not blanket recertified.
outOfScopeLegacyAssertions: Earlier catalogue claims outside the selected field excerpts keep their old reading scope; current data is not a whole-record or whole-corpus scientific recertification.
